before_final_note: Final19leaf suite runs against unmodified HEAD engine.go/think.go using a temporary overlay. It adds two parent-cancelled context-overflow finish controls to the original17leaf suite; no working-tree reversion was used.
behavior: Preserve content/reasoning/signature/metadata already emitted when the parent cancels; both silent close and explicit error chunk feed the actual completion-event persistence steps.

Error-chunk cancellations retain their original error result to callers; Execute therefore still returns nil+error in that case, but completion persistence now retains the partial step. Silent-close cancellation remains incomplete without final answer.
Return partial ChatResponse alongside cancellation errors; skip retry/synthesis and overflow recovery once the parent is stopped.
Consume pending input boundaries once through shared step construction; never replay unexecuted tool-call payloads as completed operations.
Preserve existing non-cancelled transient retry behavior and empty-response/no-artifact controls.
controls: provider tool call must not execute
prior completed tool results must not trigger synthesis after stop
context-overflow finish must not retry after stop
empty cancelled response creates no invented step
silent channel close vs explicit cancellation error
actual completion-event AgentSteps equals internal stored steps
non-cancelled transient error still retries and excludes failed-attempt reasoning
provenance: Inherited at 74434f730 and d4fadf402: engine.go cancellation predicate omits ReasoningContent/Signature/Metadata; think.go returns nil on error regardless of collected partial response.
limits: Compaction serialization number precision remains confirmed/unfixed and not started, per user stop instruction.
